newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gil-Robles voted European Parliament president.
newsitem.headline: Gil-Robles voted European Parliament president.

text.p: The European Parliament on Tuesday elected Spanish Partido Popular member Jose-Maria Gil-Robles Gil Delgado as its new president to replace German Socialist Klaus Haensch.

His election, by 338 votes to 177 for his only contender, France's Catherine Lalumiere, who won a surprisingly large protest vote, came as no surprise after a deal between the EU assembly's two biggest political groups.
Gil-Robles' first words after taking the chair included thanks to Lalumiere, who he said had increased her standing by standing in protest against the carve-up of the presidency.
"I think the votes she gained have only increased her prestige in this house," he said of the leader of the Parliament's alternative European Radical Alliance group.
Under a long-standing deal the Socialists and mainly Christian Democrat European People's Party share the presidency of the parliament's five-year legislature.
